_meta.purpose: Track per-skill quality scores across invocations

scoring_rubric.10: Perfect: correct code, right imports (dhi not pydantic), accurate perf numbers, alpha limits flagged
scoring_rubric.7: Good: mostly correct, minor issues (wrong import, missing alpha caveat)
scoring_rubric.4: Partial: core idea right but example has bugs or uses wrong API
scoring_rubric.1: Miss: wrong framework advice, pydantic instead of dhi, uvicorn instead of app.run()

outcome_definitions.pass: User gets working code or accurate answer on first try
outcome_definitions.fail: Code doesn't run or answer is wrong

_meta.update_instructions: After each scored invocation, append an entry to runs[] with date, score, outcome, and notes
